items.originalTitle: Asian stocks extend gains but traders keep eye on Nvidia crisis
items.originalSummary: Asian stocks rose Thursday to extend a global tech-led rally, though investors kept a nervous eye on Nvidia as influential boss Jensen Huang faced a probe into an affair with a woman accused of spying for China.Traders' nerves are being tested by the crisis at Nvidia, with co-founder and CEO Huang facing the boot after he admitted a relationship with Alice Huang, a senior executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed.

historyItems.title: 甲骨文納許維爾總部破土動工，承諾就業和社區投資
historyItems.summary: 新東岸園區將支援甲骨文在雲端、人工智慧和醫療保健領域的持續成長，並在田納西州奧斯汀、德克薩斯州和田納西州納許維爾創造數千個高品質就業機會。 2026 年 11 月 10 日 /美通社/ -- 甲骨文今天在納許維爾東岸舉行了未來全球總部的奠基儀式，推進了對該市作為雲、人工智慧和醫療保健技術不斷發展的中心的投資。憑藉在納許維爾的強大影響力，甲骨文繼續吸引本地和全國各地的工程和技術人才，並計劃隨著園區開發的進展創造數千個高品質就業機會。
historyItems.originalTitle: Oracle breaks ground on Nashville headquarters, pledges jobs and community investment
historyItems.originalSummary: New East Bank campus will support Oracle's continued growth in cloud, AI, and healthcare and create thousands of high-quality jobs in Tennessee AUSTIN, Texas and NASHVILLE, Tenn., Nov. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle today held its groundbreaking ceremony for its future global headquarters on Nashville's East Bank, advancing its investment in the city as a growing hub for cloud, AI, and healthcare technology. Building on its strong presence in Nashville, Oracle continues to attract engineering and technical talent locally and from across the country, with plans to create thousands of high-quality jobs as campus development progresses.

historyItems.summary: 即將到來的風暴將為新英格蘭部分地區帶來本季的第一場雪，不過從週四開始，波士頓地區將主要應對寒冷的大風雨。預計馬薩諸塞州和新英格蘭北部最高海拔地區將有幾英寸的濕雪。該系統最終將於週四晚些時候從大西洋中部海岸滑落，並發展成東北風，到週五將帶來更多的降雨、風和一些濕雪。但與今年秋天我們看到的其他東北風暴不同，我們應該避免沿海洪水等重大影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: Will it snow? Latest on potential nor’easter headed for Philly, NYC and DC
historyItems.originalSummary: An incoming storm is set to deliver the first snow of the season to parts of New England, though the Boston area will mainly contend with a cold, windswept rain starting Thursday. Several inches of wet snow are forecast for the highest elevations of Massachusetts and Northern New England. This system is set to eventually slide off the Mid-Atlantic coast late Thursday and develop into a nor’easter, bringing more rain, wind, and some wet snow through Friday. But unlike the other nor’easters we’ve seen this fall, we should avoid major impacts like coastal flooding. This one is more of an inconvenience for Greater Boston and Southern New England. • Snow — This storm holds a decent shot of delivering a coating to a couple of inches of snow along Route 2, west of I-495, and a coating to 3 inches of wet snow in a few higher-elevation spots across the Berkshires, northern Worcester County, and most of Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine, with isolated spots seeing 3 to 6 inches across the highest terrain. • Rain — For the lower elevations and by the coast, it just won’t be that cold for widespread snow. Greater Boston should end up with about a half inch of cold, windswept rain, a lot less than what we experienced last week . The same rain scenario plays out as you head south to Cape Cod, the South Coast, and Rhode Island.

historyItems.originalTitle: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
historyItems.originalSummary: A photo accompanying this announcement is available at https://www.globenewswire.com/NewsRoom/AttachmentNg/6bce8d6c-8a04-4d2e-bad7-c7d636371732 SAN DIEGO, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS), a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s initial Gateway ™ offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in subsequent years. The partnership aligns Kratos’ mission of being first to market and proven record of delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test and other vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges. The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.

The equipment comes from Caterpillar orders that San Antonio-based OnePWR Solutions placed about two years ago but needed financing to complete. historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy
historyItems.originalSummary: The artificial intelligence semiconductor giant Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, after he acknowledged a romantic relationship with businesswoman Alice Huang — also known as Huang Le — who is suspected of spying for the Chinese government. The tech mogul is not only one of the most powerful business leaders in the United States and the artificial intelligence sector; he also maintains a close relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump, who said Sunday that Huang is an “honorable guy” and should remain in his position. The executive, who will continue to lead the company — at least for the time being — sent a message to the tech giant’s employees on Sunday after U.S. media outlets published new details about the romantic relationship. In it, he admitted to being unfaithful to his wife. “I owe my family and all of you an apology... There is no excuse for what I did,” he wrote. “To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust.” The explosive situation began to come to light last month, when The New York Times broke the story about suspicions that Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese espionage operation through his relationship with Huang Le. U.S. officials had concluded last year — as reported by the Times and later by other outlets — that Alice Huang, then a senior executive at Megaspeed International, had shared information with the Chinese government while collaborating with Nvidia, the world’s most valuable company, on the construction of data centers in Asia. U.S. investigators had launched their probe amid suspicions that Megaspeed helped Beijing gain access to advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors, the shipment of which to China is prohibited. The Singapore-based company had purchased enormous quantities of these chips from Nvidia: $4.8 billion worth over the past two years. Alice Huang was responsible for these purchasing operations at Megaspeed. Her biography indicates that she worked in China as a television journalist before becoming an executive at the Singapore-based company. According to the Times, last spring Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of a classified memorandum detailing intelligence that showed Alice Huang had been recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security to lure Jensen Huang into a trap. That document circulated shortly before Trump’s visit to China in May. historyItems.originalTitle: When will it snow in New York? Latest forecast shows late-week storm potential
historyItems.originalSummary: New Yorkers could get a more noticeable taste of winter late this week as colder air spreads into the state and a developing storm potentially brings rain and snow. The latest forecasts do not support calling this a major statewide snowstorm. However, the National Weather Service is now monitoring a late-week system that could produce measurable snow in higher elevations of central and eastern New York. Lower elevations and coastal communities are more likely to receive rain, although the forecast remains uncertain. Before that system arrives, much of the state will experience seasonable to relatively mild weather. Scattered rain showers will affect parts of upstate New York through Monday, followed by a period of quieter weather in many areas. Some snow could reach parts of New York late this week, but it is too early to determine where it will accumulate or whether the storm will become disruptive. The National Weather Service in Binghamton said a clipper-type system could move into the Ohio Valley Wednesday and Thursday before potentially helping form a coastal storm by Friday. The forecast includes chances for rain and snow Thursday and Friday, with some rain and snow showers potentially lingering into Saturday. Higher elevations would have the best chance of seeing measurable snow if the storm tracks south of the region, allowing colder air to become established. The Catskills and higher terrain of central New York are among the areas to watch. Uncertainty remains high because forecast models differ on the storm's track. Even relatively small changes could determine whether a location receives snow, a rain-snow mix or primarily rain. The National Weather Service's winter weather forecasts provide snowfall projections extending out to 72 hours, including expected accumulation and lower- and higher-end possibilities. Western New York will remain unsettled into Monday, but the precipitation is initially expected to fall as rain.

historyItems.originalTitle: Microsoft Winding Down Oracle Deal to Rent AI Cloud Capacity
historyItems.originalSummary: Microsoft is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle as part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.Oracle shares were down nearly 3% in afternoon trading, while Microsoft was little changed.Microsoft has been turning off rented computing capacity from Oracle in recent months after declining to renew the contract, according to the report.Over time, the computing capacity Microsoft was renting became less valuable as it no longer met the company's evolving needs, the report added.Microsoft and Oracle did not immediately respond to Reuters’ requests for comment.

historyItems.title: 分析師降級後投資人對思科股票有何反應
historyItems.summary: 思科系統公司正在對其合作夥伴和雲端產品組合進行全面更新，包括面向合作夥伴的 Cisco IQ、擴大的 Cisco 360 合作夥伴計劃激勵措施以及將網路、安全和 AI 營運聯繫在一起的新的以 AI 為中心的工具（例如 Model Foundry 和 MCP 伺服器）。這些更新將更多的價值創造轉向遙測、重複軟體和合作夥伴驅動的生命週期工作，這與當前對硬體組合、毛利率壓力以及思科系統公司如何將其人工智慧和雲端足跡轉化為持久盈利能力的擔憂直接相互作用。我們將了解思科系統公司的投資敘述如何受到與其不斷擴大的人工智慧硬體組合相關的利潤壓力擔憂的挑戰。
historyItems.originalTitle: How Investors Are Reacting To Cisco Stock After Analyst Downgrade
historyItems.originalSummary: Cisco Systems is rolling out a broad refresh of its partner and cloud portfolios, including Cisco IQ for Partners, expanded Cisco 360 Partner Program incentives, and new AI centric tools like Model Foundry and MCP servers to tie networking, security, and AI operations together. The updates shift more value creation toward telemetry, recurring software, and partner driven lifecycle work, which interacts directly with current concerns about hardware mix, gross margin pressure, and how Cisco Systems converts its AI and cloud footprint into durable earnings power. historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile To Build New Blacklift Rocket
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile will build its own reusable Blacklift rocket with Firefly engines, sending Firefly shares up 37% while AST hit a 52-week low. Alphabet held about 9 million AST shares, worth roughly $289 million, as AST takes on rocket costs and dilution after a $231 million quarterly loss. Firefly's engine deal tops $1.3 billion, with AST paying about $800 million upfront in cash and shares that dilute current holders. Before the open on November 6, 2026, AST SpaceMobile ( NASDAQ:ASTS ) said it will build its own rocket, Blacklift, to launch its BlueBird satellites starting in late 2028. Firefly Aerospace ( NASDAQ:FLY ) will supply the engines.

historyItems.originalTitle: Why Are Western Digital (WDC) Shares Falling On AI Data Center Policy Risk?
historyItems.originalSummary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) shares fell alongside wider US tech on 5 November 2026 after renewed Democratic election momentum. Investors reacted to signals from leading Democrats that large AI data centers could face tighter federal oversight and permitting rules. Policy discussions now include potential caps on new data center projects in key US regions that host hyperscale AI facilities. The prospect of stricter AI data center regulation frames a new policy risk for Western Digital. This research explores that risk further. We have also flagged 4 other big wins for Western Digital. This storage supplier is far from the only business tied to AI infrastructure growth, so it is worth scanning peers through 53 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.title: 馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉 (Tesla) 和 SpaceX 在中期選舉後總市值損失超過 4,200 億美元
historyItems.summary: 週四下午，SpaceX和特斯拉股價分別下跌約9%和11%，投資人擔心馬斯克可能面臨新的國會調查，其公司可能在美國中期選舉後遭遇更嚴格的監管。似乎選舉結果還不夠，馬斯克投入近5億美元投入的共和黨被逐出美國國會，交易所的動盪或許只是這位世界首富懊惱的開始。自周二收盤以來，SpaceX 和特斯拉的總市值損失已超過 4,200 億美元。根據 CNBC 報導，截至週四收盤，SpaceX 和特斯拉的虧損額與科技業更廣泛的拋售同時發生。
historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX and Tesla shares fell about 9% and 11%, respectively, on Thursday afternoon as investors worried that Elon Musk could face new congressional investigations and his companies could encounter stricter regulation after the US midterm elections.As if the election results were not enough, which saw the Republican Party, which Musk poured nearly half a billion into, being pummelled out of the US Congress, the turmoil at the bourse may just be the beginning of the world's richest man's chagrin.The declines, which coincided with a broader technology-sector sell-off, pushed combined market-cap losses for SpaceX and Tesla to more than $420 billion since Tuesday’s close.As per a CNBC report, by the close of trading on Thursday, SpaceX and Tesla had lost a combined approximately $456 billion in market capitalisation.According to Forbes, which keeps a reliable database of the richest in the world, Musk’s net worth, which exceeded $1 trillion after SpaceX’s initial public offering in June, has now fallen below $800 billion. He lost about $90 billion over the past week but remains the world’s richest person.Musk was the largest donor to Republican candidates and causes during the midterms, contributing more than $470 million, the Financial Times first reported.Despite his support for the GOP’s fundraising efforts, most of the candidates Musk backed lost their races.Democrats secured control of both the House and Senate. In Texas, home to both Tesla and SpaceX, Democratic Sen.-elect James Talarico and Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa defeated longtime Musk allies: state Attorney General Ken Paxton and Gov. Greg Abbott.Tesla and SpaceX are expanding their AI infrastructure in Texas and plan to build Terafab, a massive complex in Grimes County that will house both a data center and a sprawling semiconductor factory.According to company job postings, SpaceX also intends to develop a “supercomputer” at Starbase, its launch facility and company town in Texas.Deutsche Bank analysts, who spoke to CNBC, have warned that SpaceX’s computing expansion in Texas may face delays. They said the company could need to raise capital spending to comply with stricter regulations expected to govern data centre development.CNN first reported, citing an aide to a Democratic senator, that Musk and SpaceX had been instructed to retain records related to restrictions on a military version of Starlink in Ukraine. Those restrictions limited Ukraine’s ability to defend itself against Russian attacks.Regulatory scrutiny could also jeopardise Musk’s proposed merger of SpaceX and Tesla, an idea he has promoted while acknowledging that it would first require shareholder approval.Read Also: Hyundai cars can now cut your insurance premium by up to 15% if you drive safely

historyItems.originalTitle: US proposes space launch rule changes in potential boost for SpaceX
historyItems.originalSummary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposed changes to commercial space launch and re-entry rules. The move aims to reduce licensing delays and support a rapid rise in launch activity across the country.The proposals could particularly benefit Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin. Both companies operate high-frequency launch programs and require repeated regulatory approvals for rockets, satellites and reusable vehicles..What the FAA Proposes.The FAA has put forward three key changes. First, operators would gain flexibility to switch off a rocket’s flight-termination system earlier in a mission and reactivate it later, provided they meet the agency’s safety conditions for that phase.Second, the regulator proposes clearer rules on when a launch must be aborted. The revised language would explain how companies should assess the risks of ending a flight early versus allowing it to continue after it can no longer achieve its objective.Third, the FAA wants to simplify how operators assess spacecraft breakup during uncontrolled re-entry. Companies could use existing debris analyses to show that fragments are unlikely to cause multiple casualties on the ground..A Boost for SpaceX.The changes would make launch approvals easier for SpaceX and Blue Origin, according to the FAA. SpaceX, which dominates US commercial launch activity, stands to gain the most since it conducts missions at a far higher cadence than its rivals.Faster approvals could help SpaceX expand Starlink satellite deployments, accelerate Starship development and reduce waiting periods between missions. Blue Origin could also benefit as it scales its New Glenn rocket program.The proposals follow earlier FAA moves to allow electronic launch applications, combine three safety analyses into one submission and give operators greater flexibility in demonstrating safe operations..Preparing for Higher Launch Volumes.The White House wants at least 1,000 commercial launches and re-entries annually by 2030. That target compares with 178 launches last year and marks a tenfold increase from 2013.To manage this growth, the FAA is expanding its Office of Commercial Space Transportation. It has named an associate administrator and is hiring aerospace engineers to speed up safety reviews and mission authorisations.The agency also plans a broader overhaul of its space-licensing framework beginning in 2027. The initiative signals a shift towards a more predictable and scalable regulatory system for the commercial space economy.Also Read: Qualcomm to Supply 5G Technology for SpaceX's Nationwide Network.Join our WhatsApp Channel to get the latest news, exclusives and videos on WhatsApp

historyItems.originalTitle: Morgan Stanley Downgrades Cisco On AI Impacting Gross Margins
historyItems.originalSummary: Morgan Stanley's Meta Marshall downgraded Cisco after a 43% rally, warning that AI hardware margin pressure leaves less upside while Ciena and Arista fall harder. The post-midterm AI selloff has spread from chips to optical suppliers Lumentum and Coherent, as fears grow that Democratic control of Congress will curb infrastructure spending. Cisco's diversified customer base cushions its drop, while Ciena's 53% hyperscaler revenue and Arista's 64x valuation leave both more exposed to AI sentiment swings.

historyItems.summary: 知情人士透露，由於曠日持久的勞資糾紛，美光科技公司暫停了在台灣建設記憶體晶片工廠的計劃，這讓關鍵人工智慧 (AI) 組件主要生產基地的命運受到質疑。知情人士稱，這家美國公司幾乎停止了在桃園的一家工廠的建設。由於討論是私下進行的，因此要求匿名。高層擔心越來越多的不確定性，包括與當地工會達成的協議被推翻的風險。知情人士稱，美光科技已向台灣官員和一家供應商通報其暫停在該市建設的計劃。
historyItems.originalTitle: Micron Pauses Work on $4.5 Billion Taiwan Plant After Labor Spat
historyItems.originalSummary: Micron Technology Inc has suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan due to a protracted labor dispute, according to people familiar with the matter, throwing into question the fate of a major production base for crucial artificial intelligence (AI) components. The US company has all but halted construction of a plant in Taoyuan, said the people, who asked not to be identified because the deliberations are private. Executives are concerned about mounting uncertainties, including the risk that an agreement with a local labor union will get overturned. Micron has informed Taiwanese officials and a supplier about its plans to suspend construction in the city, the people said. Tensions between Micron and its workers flared this year after employees demanded higher compensation, seeking more of the record profits generated from the AI build-out. The potential disruption to Micron’s plans in Taiwan — an island that produces three-fifths of the US firm’s conventional chips — threatens to further cloud a market already grappling with endemic shortages of memory. Micron — which has invested close to US$50 billion in Taiwan over three decades — had planned on making high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM at the new Taoyuan plant using top-end equipment from ASML Holding NV. While it isn’t considered a giant facility by modern standards, those components are intertwined with Nvidia Corp accelerators and the global AI data center boom, and in such short supply that prices are skyrocketing. “Taiwan plays an important role in Micron’s global footprint, and our operations today continue as normal,” Micron said in a statement, without addressing questions about the Taoyuan complex. “We are confident in maintaining business continuity for our customers.” Micron secured a deal with the bigger of its two unions last month, but the company may need to renegotiate because some employees are balking at the terms, according to the people. The suspension raises the possibility Micron will reconsider plans for its broader manufacturing hub in Taiwan, which helps it compete with South Korea’s Samsung Electronics Co and SK Hynix Inc, and China’s CXMT Corp (長鑫存儲). Micron had budgeted US$3 billion to US$4.5 billion toward the Taoyuan complex, which included purchases of ASML gear, one of the people said. There’s still some minor work being done on the site to ensure its safety, but construction will freeze after that, the people added. Dubbed Fab 11E, it was previously scheduled to come online in 2028. Micron is Taiwan’s largest foreign investor, and it would be a major blow to the island if the company scaled back there. Taiwan’s economy and stock market have gotten a boost from the AI boom, with the likes of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. building plants at an unprecedented pace. Yet its viability as a long-term investment destination is at risk from potential Chinese military intervention.

historyItems.originalTitle: Skyworks Stock Sinks as Android Woes Delay the Qorvo’s Merger Payoff
historyItems.originalSummary: IRVINE, Calif., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: SWKS), a global leader in high-performance RF, precision timing, power management and mixed-signal solutions, today reported fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year 2026 results for the period ended Oct. 2, 2026. Skyworks’ revenue for its fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 was $1,046 million. Skyworks’ GAAP diluted earnings per share were $0.15 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.28. For fiscal year 2026, Skyworks’ revenue was $3.96 billion, with GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.14 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.05. “Today marks a new chapter for Skyworks,” said Phil Brace, chief executive officer and president of Skyworks. “Combining with Qorvo gives us the scale and the technology breadth to lead the next era of wireless, as AI moves from the infrastructure to the devices, vehicles and machines around us. In Smartphone, our portfolio now spans the RF front-end, from power management to the antenna, as 5G-Advanced and 6G drive a new cycle of RF complexity. In Diversified Growth Markets, our complementary RF GaN, power, and timing solutions expand our reach across Physical AI and Connected Edge, Defense and Aerospace, Infrastructure, and Automotive. Our focus now is execution: delivering for our customers, achieving $500 million or more of annual cost synergies and building a stronger, more diversified Skyworks.” Basis of Presentation and New Revenue Categories “Because our combination with Qorvo closed after the end of our fiscal fourth quarter, our reported September-quarter results are Skyworks standalone,” said Philip Carter, chief financial officer and senior vice president of Skyworks. “Combined September-quarter revenue of approximately $1.98 billion, which includes an additional week in Qorvo’s fiscal quarter, provides the starting point for our first quarter as a combined company. Beginning with our first fiscal quarter of 2027, we will report on a fully combined basis, with Smartphone and Diversified Growth Markets as our revenue categories.”

historyItems.originalTitle: Shares of Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Tumble After Republican Losses
historyItems.originalSummary: Thank you for your patience while we verify access. Elon Musk spent nearly $500 million supporting Republican candidates in the midterm elections, especially in his home state, Texas. After Democrats won sweeping victories, gaining control of both houses of Congress and capturing other important state races, shares of SpaceX and Tesla, which are both run by Mr. Musk, fell sharply on Wednesday. Tesla’s stock dropped when markets opened, and closed down more than 3 percent. SpaceX, which conducted a blockbuster public offering in June, followed a similar pattern, and was nearly 4 percent lower by the end of trading. The declines stood out among tech stocks, as Meta, Microsoft, Google and the wider stock market rallied at the start of trading. SpaceX and Tesla are exploring a merger , which could be complicated by a Congress controlled by Democrats, some of whom have already signaled their intent to investigate the world’s richest person and his companies. In recent years, Mr. Musk has antagonized Democrats, spending heavily to elect President Trump, involving himself deeply in firing federal workers and shutting down government agencies while aligning his companies’ interests with those of the administration. “They are going to need to plant new forests for all of the subpoenas we’ll be printing,” Senator Edward J. Markey, Democrat of Massachusetts, posted on X on Tuesday night about potential hearings for technology executives.

historyItems.summary: 11 月 3 日星期二，民主黨在 2026 年中期選舉中大獲全勝，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下公司 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股價在第二天早上暴跌。 《紐約時報》11 月 4 日星期三報導稱，開盤時，特斯拉股價下跌超過 5%，SpaceX 股價下跌超過 7%，隨後收復了部分跌幅。據該媒體報道，這位 55 歲的世界首富在中期選舉中投入了至少 4.74 億美元，試圖讓共和黨繼續掌權，這比美國選舉週期中任何捐助者花費的錢都多，這還不包括為自己競選公職提供資金的候選人。
historyItems.originalTitle: Shares in Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Tesla Fall Premarket After Democrats Sweep Midterms
historyItems.originalSummary: As Democrats swept the 2026 midterm elections on Tuesday, November 3, shares of Elon Musk 's companies SpaceX and Tesla tumbled the following morning. The New York Times reported on Wednesday, November 4, that when markets opened, Tesla's stock fell more than 5 percent, and SpaceX fell more than 7 percent before recovering some of those losses. The world's richest man, 55, poured at least $474 million into the midterms in an attempt to keep Republicans in power, spending more money than any donor in a U.S. election cycle, not counting candidates who have funded their own runs for office, according to the outlet.

historyItems.summary: 太空探索科技公司（Space Exploration Technologies Corp.，簡稱 SpaceX）（SPCX +8.62%）於 2026 年 6 月 12 日完成了期待已久的首次公開發行 (IPO)。這家衛星、火箭和人工智慧公司是有史以來規模最大的 IPO，籌集了 750 億美元（幾乎是沙烏地阿美公司 2019 年籌集的 256 億美元的三倍）。 SpaceX 將 IPO 定價為每股 135 美元（估值高達 1.75 兆美元）。自上市以來，這家太空和人工智慧公司讓投資者陷入了瘋狂的旅程。
historyItems.originalTitle: How to Invest In SpaceX (SPCX) — And How Not To
historyItems.originalSummary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp ., or SpaceX ( SPCX +8.62% ), completed its long-awaited initial public offering (IPO) on June 12, 2026. The satellite, rocket, and AI company is the largest IPO ever, raising $75 billion (nearly triple the $25.6 billion raised by Saudi Aramco in 2019). SpaceX priced its IPO at $135 a share (a staggering $1.75 trillion valuation). The space and AI company has taken investors on a wild ride since going public. It initially popped to about $225 per share right after its IPO, then tumbled below $105 per share by early August. SpaceX has since recovered and was trading back above its IPO price by early November. Invest better with The Motley Fool. Get stock recommendations, portfolio guidance, and more from The Motley Fool's premium services.

historyItems.summary: Salesforce 週一表示，Salesforce 已簽署收購 Cresta 的最終協議，後者的語音代理商從頭到尾處理複雜的客戶呼叫。該交易應在 Salesforce 2028 財年第一季完成，具體取決於監管部門的批准。 Salesforce 並未透露價格。據 Valida Pau 和 Kevin McLaughlin 向 The Information 報道，據一位知情人士透露，該公司同意支付 27 億美元。
historyItems.originalTitle: Cresta Fills An Important Gap In Salesforce’s Customer Service AI Story
historyItems.originalSummary: Salesforce has signed a definitive agreement to buy Cresta, whose voice agents handle complex customer calls from start to finish, Salesforce said on Monday. The deal should close in the first quarter of Salesforce’s fiscal year 2028, subject to regulatory approvals. Salesforce did not disclose a price. It agreed to pay $2.7bn, according to a person familiar with the deal, as Valida Pau and Kevin McLaughlin reported for The Information . TNW has not independently verified the figure. Cresta is nine years old and started out at Stanford University’s AI Lab, The Information reported. The deal builds up Salesforce’s customer service business, the outlet wrote. Cresta calls itself a voice-first operating system for customer experience. Its voice agents hold natural, real-time conversations and handle interruptions, Salesforce said. Marriott, Comcast and Alaska Airlines use them at enterprise scale. The same platform guides human representatives during live calls and analyses every interaction. It also coaches staff and tests the voice agents, holding both to the same quality standard. “Voice is where service is hardest to get right, and where it matters most to customers,” said Kishan Chetan, EVP and GM of Agentforce and Service Cloud at Salesforce. Salesforce plans to join Cresta with Service Cloud, its customer service software. The aim is to link each conversation to the customer’s history and to the outcome, which Salesforce lists as resolution, retention and revenue. After the deal closes, Cresta will keep supporting the contact centre and telephony platforms its customers use today, Salesforce said. “Now, by uniting our platform with Salesforce, we will realize our full vision at scale, embedding real-time conversation intelligence and agentic experiences directly into Salesforce’s first-class customer service Platform,” said Ping Wu, chief executive of Cresta. Cresta follows other recent Salesforce deals. It agreed a $5.7bn Braze deal on 20 October. Days before Cresta, it announced plans to buy Rune , a national security software company.

historyItems.summary: 卡特彼勒 (NYSE:CAT) 完成了對 Cat 長期經銷商 John Fabick Tractor Company 的收購，並於 2026 年 11 月 2 日宣布完成交易。該交易重點關注密蘇裡州、伊利諾伊州、威斯康辛州和密西根州上半島，旨在保持客戶支援和服務連續性。 Caterpillar 表示，此次收購支持無縫的所有權過渡，同時維持 Fabick 的現有服務和本地客戶支援。卡特彼勒對約翰法比克拖拉機公司的收購很重要，儘管投資者應該權衡的不僅僅是這一單一經銷商交易。
historyItems.originalTitle: Caterpillar Completes Fabick Cat Acquisition, Names New CEO
historyItems.originalSummary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) completed its acquisition of John Fabick Tractor Company, a long-time Cat dealer, announcing the closing on November 2, 2026. The deal focuses on Missouri, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Michigan's Upper Peninsula, aiming to keep customer support and service continuity in place. Caterpillar says the acquisition supports a seamless ownership transition while maintaining Fabick's existing service and local customer support. Caterpillar's acquisition of John Fabick Tractor Company is important, although investors should weigh more than this single dealer deal. We have also flagged 1 warning sign for Caterpillar. The focus on regional dealer coverage is shared by many industrial and infrastructure players, so it can be useful to compare Caterpillar with peers exposed to similar AI-related equipment and services through 54 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.originalTitle: Does Amphenol (APH) Gain An Edge In AI Infrastructure From This New Partnership?
historyItems.originalSummary: Amphenol (NYSE:APH) unit Charles Industries entered a nationwide partnership with Rep Com International covering telecom, broadband, and AI infrastructure markets. The agreement gives Rep Com International responsibility for distributing Charles Industries products across its U.S. sales network. The collaboration focuses on expanding access to Charles Industries outside plant, enclosure, and related solutions for communications and AI data infrastructure projects. The Rep Com International and Charles Industries distribution expansion is important. Investors should weigh it alongside other Amphenol developments. We have also flagged 1 warning sign for Amphenol. historyItems.originalTitle: Aehr Test Systems: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
historyItems.originalSummary: On its first quarter of fiscal 2027 earnings call, held on Nov. 2, 2026, Aehr Test Systems ( AEHR +5.59% ) raised its full-year revenue outlook to $150 million after sales tripled year over year. The semiconductor test equipment manufacturer is capitalizing on rapid capacity expansion across artificial intelligence (AI) processors and optical interconnects. Expanding production requirements across multiple customer accounts provide meaningful operating leverage as shipment volumes scale. Three key takeaways from management explain how this growth trajectory affects long-term value. Aehr Test spent years dependent on a narrow group of customers for the bulk of its revenue. Management has expanded its active pipeline across more than 12 customers in AI processors, silicon photonics, silicon carbide, and gallium nitride, creating a broader base for multiyear revenue growth. Order activity drove effective backlog, which includes confirmed customer orders awaiting shipment, to $109 million as of Nov. 1. That order volume gives management strong revenue visibility and allows it to scale asset-light manufacturing capacity through third-party factory partners in Southeast Asia without heavy capital expenditures. A major AI accelerator supplier completed a benchmark evaluation and ordered a full test cell for evaluation at an outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partner in Taiwan. Testing multi-chip processor packages before final assembly prevents costly chip failures, positioning Aehr Test for high-volume production orders across multiple product lines. Demand for AI processors is accelerating rapidly, and execution is matching pace. Aehr Test maintains a proprietary technology position in full-wafer contactors and multi-zone thermal control. Management is watching customer qualification timelines and contract manufacturing capacity expansion. Converting ongoing benchmark evaluations into high-volume production orders forms the foundation for long-term expansion.

historyItems.summary: 美國電力生產商瑞致達 (Vistra) 已完成對 Cogentrix Energy 的收購，新增 10 座天然氣發電廠，總裝置容量約 5.5GW。這些資產是在獲得必要的監管許可後從量子資本集團管理的基金中收購的。此後，瑞致達在美國的總發電量將增加至近50GW。
historyItems.originalTitle: Latham & Watkins Advises Vistra on Completed Acquisition of Cogentrix Natural Gas Portfolio
historyItems.originalSummary: US-based power producer Vistra has closed the acquisition of Cogentrix Energy, adding 10 natural gas power plants with a combined capacity of about 5.5GW. The assets were acquired from funds managed by Quantum Capital Group, following receipt of the necessary regulatory clearances. With this addition, Vistra's total power generation capacity in the US rises to nearly 50GW.

historyItems.originalTitle: Aehr Test Systems Reports Record First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Revenue of $33.0 Million; Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook to $150 Million, Triple Fiscal 2026 Revenue
historyItems.originalSummary: Aehr Test ( (AEHR) ) has held its Q1 earnings call. Read on for the main highlights of the call. Aehr Test’s earnings call carried a strongly positive tone, driven by record revenue, surging bookings, profit growth and a raised fiscal 2027 outlook. Management also highlighted expanding AI and data-center programs, stronger consumables sales, customer diversification, manufacturing investments and a debt-free balance sheet, while noting margin pressure, shipment timing risks and slower NAND progress. Aehr Test reported record first-quarter revenue of $33 million, up 200% year over year and 75% sequentially. Non-GAAP net income rose to $9.4 million, or $0.28 per diluted share, compared with $200,000, or $0.01 per share, a year earlier. Bookings reached $46.7 million, more than four times the prior-year figure, producing a 1.4 book-to-bill ratio. Quarter-end backlog rose to $100.9 million from $80.6 million at fiscal 2026 year-end, while effective backlog reached about $109 million after later orders. Non-GAAP gross margin improved to 48.5% from 37.5% a year earlier, helped by higher volume and a better product mix. Revenue grew 200%, while non-GAAP operating expenses rose about 36%, showing the benefit of scale. Demand for Aehr’s FOX wafer-level burn-in systems is accelerating, led by a $22 million follow-on order from an AI processor customer. The order covers automated FOX XP systems, WaferPak aligners and full-wafer contactors as the customer expands production capacity. A major supplier of AI accelerators, CPUs and network processors completed a benchmark and decided to buy a FOX XP production test cell. Installation at a Taiwan-based OSAT is planned for early 2027, but high-volume adoption still depends on validation in a production environment. Aehr received additional production orders for FOX XP systems used to test photonic integrated circuits. Management said wider use of optical interconnects, including co-packaged optics, could create further demand for wafer-level reliability screening in data centers. Additional WaferPak orders and higher utilization of installed FOX systems pointed to improving silicon carbide demand. Aehr also added two gallium nitride production customers in six months and described itself as the market leader in that segment. Aehr is shipping and installing more than a dozen Sonoma systems monthly for a lead customer’s first AI processor. The customer’s second processor completed qualification, generating follow-on orders for systems, burn-in modules and software tied to initial production sampling.

historyItems.originalTitle: Driven by A.I. Boom, Marvell and Lumentum Announce $115 Billion Merger
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell Technology on Monday announced a $115 billion stock swap to buy Lumentum Holdings, in a major bet that a technology known as optical networking will be crucial to the build-out of data centers for artificial intelligence. The transaction between the two Silicon Valley companies, which includes Lumentum’s debt, would rank as the largest ever by value between publicly held tech companies. Marvell makes an array of chips for networking and A.I. The 31-year-old company has been growing rapidly by acquisition since Matthew Murphy joined it as chief executive in 2016. Lumentum makes lasers and a series of other chips and components that use light to transmit data signals, a mainstay of long-distance communications known as optical networking, which is increasingly used inside data centers.

historyItems.originalTitle: What Is the Intel 14A PDK 0.9, and Why Does It Matter to Foundry Customers?
historyItems.originalSummary: The Intel 14A process design kit (PDK) 0.9 gives foundry customers a more mature, silicon-validated environment for designing products on the Intel 14A process node. This milestone is an important step toward the Intel 14A PDK 1.0 and high-volume manufacturing readiness. Silicon process technologies provide a range of transistors, interconnects and specialized features that chip designers leverage to build their products. For a foundry customer to use these features, they need a way to incorporate them into their designs. This is where the process design kit (PDK) comes in. A PDK serves as the interface between the process technology and the design tools engineers use to turn their ideas into silicon. If you think of a chip as a microscopic but vast city, a PDK is the digital building codes, approved building materials, and helpful resources that allow a designer to create a successful product. Intel Foundry recently announced the general availability of the PDK 0.9 for the Intel 14A process node, an important milestone that allows customers to use the technology in an environment closer to full scale production. We asked Ben Sell, who leads Intel 14A and advanced nodes development, and Ali Farhang, who oversees PDKs and design enablement, to talk about the importance of this release, PDKs in general, and what’s next for the Intel 14A node. Let’s start with the basics. What exactly is a PDK, and why is it important when you develop a new process technology? Ali: A Process Design Kit, or PDK, is essentially the ultimate reference guide for a chip designer to create a product on a specific manufacturing process. It brings together the models, design rules, and other supporting materials that electronic design automation (EDA) tools use to help a customer bring their product from concept to mass production. Just as importantly, the PDK release lifecycle serves as the clock that orchestrates technology development. Each revision represents a milestone of technology maturity, synchronizing our internal research and development, EDA and IP ecosystem partners, and customer design teams on a single, shared schedule. Can you tell us what it means for Intel Foundry to announce general availability of the Intel 14A PDK 0.9? Ben: From a customer perspective, the PDK 0.9 gives customers the confidence to design products on Intel 14A, as the technology is reaching the industry-standard performance and yield maturity expected at this stage of development, supported by silicon-backed validation. Process technologies take time to mature for production, but customers want early access to begin design evaluation to enable time-to-market. With PDK 0.9, customers can create designs that go into the fab for production around the time a process node is certified. As we approach PDK 1.0, it says that we are confident that this process technology is on track for high volume manufacturing.

historyItems.originalTitle: Valuation Compression Pulls Down KLA (KLAC) Despite Raised Outlook
historyItems.originalSummary: Bristol Gate Capital Partners , an investment management company, published its Q3 2026 investor letter for the "US Equity Strategy". The letter can be downloaded here . The US Equity Strategy lagged the S&P 500 (+2.3%) in Q3 2026, as declines in industrial and semiconductor-equipment holdings weighed against gains in tech. Despite this relative drag, the strategy continued to outpace the index in terms of dividend growth. Portfolio fundamentals were solid in the quarter, with 21 out of 22 holdings exceeding earnings forecasts, six raising guidance, and several boosting dividends. Key contributors included Microsoft, Cintas, and McKesson, while KLA, Applied Materials, and GE Aerospace negatively impacted performance. Bristol Gate's portfolio remains positioned for long-term compounding via robust balance sheets and cash-flow-funded dividend growth, providing resilience against high interest rates, top-heavy market concentration, and AI credit friction. Also, check the Fund's top five holdings to see its best picks for 2026.

Balance Sheet: Total assets of $4 billion (including $1.8 billion net fixed assets and $2 billion current assets); record shareholders' equity of $3.2 billion (80% of total assets); current ratio of ~3.7x. CapEx: $920 million SiPho and SiGe investment plan, ~65% paid to date with remaining 35% expected in Q4 2026 and H1 2027; expected full ROI within one year.

historyItems.originalTitle: Here’s What a $10,000 Investment in TSMC Stock Will Be Worth by 2030
historyItems.originalSummary: When you hear investors talk about AI, names like Nvidia ( NVDA +3.50% ) and AMD ( AMD +11.03% ) pop up all the time. While those are great stock picks, investors can also go a layer deeper and look at a stock like Taiwan Semiconductor ( TSM +6.28% ) . Taiwan Semiconductor is a chip foundry, which means that it manufactures the chips that giants like Nvidia and AMD design. Because it's selling its services to most of the competitors in the AI chip race, TSMC is set to keep profiting from the infrastructure build-out no matter which of them is gaining or losing ground. All TSMC cares about is whether companies are spending more and more on data centers each year. If they are, then TSMC will need to produce more chips to meet demand. Considering the language the market has heard from some of the AI hyperscalers and computing unit providers recently, I'd say it's a safe bet that 2027 will be another year for the record books. That bodes well for TSMC, and I think a $5,000 investment made now could be worth far more by 2030.

historyItems.originalTitle: Intel Plunges After PC Slump and Supply Snags Hurt Outlook
historyItems.originalSummary: [SAN FRANCISCO] Intel plunged in late trading after its revenue forecast missed analysts’ estimates, hurt by sputtering demand for PC processors and supply chain problems with its lucrative data centre components. Sales in the fourth quarter will be US$15 billion to US$16 billion, the company said on Thursday (Oct 29) in a statement. Analysts, on average, estimated US$17 billion and some projections topped US$18 billion, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. Profit will be US$0.25 a share in the quarter, excluding certain items. Wall Street was projecting adjusted earnings of US$0.43 a share.

historyItems.title: 英特爾第三季獲利超出預期，但因 PC 銷售疲軟，股價暴跌 20%，未能達到第四季預期
historyItems.summary: 英特爾公司 INTC 報告了 2026 年第三季的穩健業績，調整後的收益和收入超過了 Zacks 的普遍預期。儘管個人電腦市場疲軟，但在人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資的推動下，對伺服器處理器的強勁需求支撐了營收成長。非 GAAP 收益年增 126.1% 至每股 52 美分，比市場普遍預期的 39 美分高出 33.33%。營收成長 20.9%，達到 165.1 億美元，比市場普遍預期的 164.4 億美元高出 0.44%。
historyItems.originalTitle: Intel tops Q3 earnings estimates, but falls short of Q4 outlook on sluggish PC sales as stock plunges 20%
historyItems.originalSummary: Intel Corporation INTC reported solid third-quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings and revenues beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate. Strong demand for server processors, driven by artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, supported top-line growth despite weakness in the PC market. Non-GAAP earnings surged 126.1% year over year to 52 cents per share, surpassing the consensus estimate of 39 cents by 33.33%. Revenues increased 20.9% to $16.51 billion, beating the consensus estimate of $16.44 billion by 0.44%. Data Center and AI revenues jumped 78% year over year, reflecting strong demand across hyperscale, enterprise and neo-cloud customers. However, a soft fourth-quarter outlook overshadowed the feel-good factor for investors and shares plunged more than 25% in pre-market trading.
